![](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/0b7c81c03d70eca2ec0dfe167c687d6b02dfaf20c568b29332b808073ea24c58?s=48&d=initials&r=g&initials=AS)

###### Table of Contents:

[Making Growth Priority #1 for Your Coworking Space](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#PGEgaWQ9InBvc3QtMzU0NjYtX25hM2dxcmk1OHN6aiI-PC9hPk1ha2luZyBHcm93dGggUHJpb3JpdHkgIzEgZm9yIFlvdXIgQ293b3JraW5nIFNwYWNl) [#1 Work on Your Digital Storefront](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#IzEgV29yayBvbiBZb3VyIERpZ2l0YWwgU3RvcmVmcm9udA) [#2 Track Leads Through Data](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#IzIgVHJhY2sgTGVhZHMgVGhyb3VnaCBEYXRh) [#3 Finetune Your Tours](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#IzMgRmluZXR1bmUgWW91ciBUb3Vycw) [#4 Have a Smooth Onboarding Process](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#IzQgSGF2ZSBhIFNtb290aCBPbmJvYXJkaW5nIFByb2Nlc3M) [#5 Market to Those Passing Through](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#IzUgTWFya2V0IHRvIFRob3NlIFBhc3NpbmcgVGhyb3VnaA) [#6 Turn Your Coworking Space Into an Events Hub](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#IzYgVHVybiBZb3VyIENvd29ya2luZyBTcGFjZSBJbnRvIGFuIEV2ZW50cyBIdWI) [#7 Upsell to Existing Members](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#IzcgVXBzZWxsIHRvIEV4aXN0aW5nIE1lbWJlcnM) [#8 Listen to Your Members](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#IzggTGlzdGVuIHRvIFlvdXIgTWVtYmVycw) [#9 Take Advantage of Referrals](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#IzkgVGFrZSBBZHZhbnRhZ2Ugb2YgUmVmZXJyYWxz) [Grow Your Space with OfficeRnD Flex](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#PGEgaWQ9InBvc3QtMzU0NjYtX29zaWZ0bDFzMjllbSI-PC9hPkdyb3cgWW91ciBTcGFjZSB3aXRoIE9mZmljZVJuRCBGbGV4) [FAQ](https://www.officernd.com/blog/how-to-grow-a-coworking-space/#PGEgaWQ9InBvc3QtMzU0NjYtX3J6bmNpMG8yYWtybSI-PC9hPkZBUQ)

You might have turned your vision of the perfect coworking space into a reality, but your work isn’t finished yet. In fact, this just spells the beginning of the work!

If you want your business to last, it’s crucial to attract more members, keep current members happy, and foster a sense of community.

[![](https://www.officernd.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/In-Article-Banner_812x194px-6.svg)](https://www.officernd.com/campaign/flex-space-tech-stack-report/?utm_medium=website&utm_source=blog-banners&utm_campaign=flex-and-coworking-ebook-tech-stack-report-2026)

This article will walk you through how to grow a coworking space through nine marketing strategies. These range from using technology to your advantage to creating a hub for local events.

* * *

**Quick Summary:**

*   Coworking spaces are becoming more popular than ever.
*   Owners should work on their online presence, track data, fine-tune their tours, and offer referrals.
*   They can also maximize their existing members through onboarding, events, upselling, and listening to their feedback.

* * *

## Making Growth Priority #1 for Your Coworking Space

The global coworking space market was estimated to be worth [$10.53 billion](https://www.zionmarketresearch.com/report/co-working-space-market) in 2023, and it’s expected to grow by 14.5% between 2024 and 2032

You might think this growth shows the coworking industry is doing well, so you can be sure about the future of your own business. But it may not be so easy.

[Forecasts suggest](https://www.statista.com/statistics/554273/number-of-coworking-spaces-worldwide/) the number of coworking spaces across the world will go from 19,345 in 2021 to 41,975 in 2024. While this shows steady growth, it also means that owners of coworking spaces can’t get too comfortable.

The competition is high, and you need to make sure you stand out. Fortunately, the rest of this guide is focused on the best tips and strategies to help you achieve exactly that.

![](https://www.officernd.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/word-image-35466-1.jpg)

## #1 Work on Your Digital Storefront

Most leads will find your website or social media before they know anything about you. Making a good impression here may be even more important than making sure your coworking space looks good in person.

Plus, [common industries using coworking](https://www.officernd.com/blog/common-industries-that-use-coworking/#:~:text=The%20most%20common%20industries%20that,office%20rentals%20to%20networking%20opportunities.) include the tech and creative sectors, which are full of highly tech-literate professionals. They may judge you more harshly on your website’s appearance than those from other industries.

Your digital presence should:

*   Include membership fees and rate structure
*   List available amenities
*   Have an easy-to-navigate layout
*   Highlights what makes your coworking space unique

Social media can also be a chance to connect with potential customers on a more personal level. You may want to go beyond typical branding choices and give people a “feel” of the coworking space instead.

Why not shine a light on current members’ entrepreneurial journeys to showcase the kind of [coworking community](https://www.officernd.com/blog/community-building-in-coworking-spaces/) customers can expect to find? Or film the facilities so customers can check them out from the comfort of their sofas?

## #2 Track Leads Through Data

Good growth plans aren’t pulled out of thin air — they should be informed by tracking data. This informs you about crucial info, such as where your leads are coming from. You can then use this to nudge them toward becoming customers.

For example, you might find that most of your [website visitors](https://www.officernd.com/blog/coworking-space-website/) come from Instagram and decide to pay for an ad campaign on the platform.

When you figure out what works and what doesn’t, you can make data-driven decisions to inform future marketing choices. Continuing the example above, you may decide to stick to Instagram because it’s delivering the results you want. Or, you might discover that another advertising platform is more effective at bringing in leads.

With data reporting and visualization tools, you can also run reports on [coworking KPIs](https://www.officernd.com/blog/coworking-kpis/) such as [occupancy rates](https://www.officernd.com/blog/occupancy-rates-guide/) and a number of new memberships sold. You can also gain insight in
